Namaste,

My own journey began with healing myself. Over the years I moved from inner conflict to clarity, and from struggle to alignment, by studying Advaita Vedanta and the Upanishads and testing every idea on my own life first.

So I won't ask you to believe anything I say. In our sessions we practise together, and you feel the change for yourself. That is all Know Thyself means. The Upanishads put it in two words: आत्मानं विद्धि, know your own Self.

If something here speaks to you, start with the free Gratitude Session. And if you have a question, just write to us.

With love,
Anurag

you asked

Common questions

Still unsure which program fits? Write to us and we will help you choose.

Where should I start if I'm new?

Start with the free Gratitude Session. If it resonates, try Mental Detox or Intentional Alignment before moving to a signature program.

Are the programs live or recorded?

Gratitude, Mental Detox, Intentional Alignment and Quantum Alignment are recorded, so you can follow them at your own pace. Awaken Your Healing Intelligence runs over 12 sessions. The Know Thyself retreat is live and residential.

Where and when is the next retreat?

Know Thyself runs 23–28 May 2027 in Goa. It is a 6-day residential retreat with limited seats.

How do I pay?

Payments go through Razorpay's secure checkout. Prices shown are before tax.

Can I invite Anurag to speak at my event?

Yes. Anurag speaks at organisations, conferences and communities. Email ar.happinessmovement@gmail.com with your event details.

About Anurag Rishi

With one vision: to see India stand first on the World Happiness Index.

Anurag Rishi is a holistic wellness practitioner and spiritual researcher. Many people call him a Modern Rishi, because he connects old Indian wisdom with today's science and with everyday life.

His teaching draws on Advaita Vedanta, the Upanishads and classical Indian healing, read alongside quantum physics, psychology and mind–body science. The difference is that he does not teach theory. Each idea he shares, he has first tried on himself and made part of his own life.

It started with his own healing. Years of study, reflection and steady practice moved him from inner conflict to clarity, from struggle to alignment, and from just getting by to living with abundance. Only after that change did he start teaching.

He has a gift for making big spiritual and scientific ideas simple, using examples anyone can relate to. He does not hand people beliefs. He gives them experiences, so they can feel for themselves how inner alignment shapes healing, choices and results in life.

His work now reaches people in more than 30 countries. The Know Thyself retreats in particular are immersive and hands-on: not motivational events, but carefully held spaces for healing, clarity and conscious manifestation.

He teaches only what he has practiced.
And he shares only what he has lived.

the goal

By 2028, make India #1 in the World Happiness Index

The World Happiness Index measures how happy people are and how good life feels in each country. Through wellness programs that care for mental and emotional health, Anurag wants to change lives one person at a time across India: more mindfulness, less stress, and stronger communities, until the whole country rises to the top.
